acip: MA GRUB NA, GSER BUM ZANGS BUM GNYIS CHOS CAN, BUM PA MA YIN PA LAS LOG PA YIN PAR THAL, BUM PA YIN PA'I PHYIR,
english: I disagree that the pair of a porcelain coffee cup and a glass coffee cup is the opposite of all which is not a coffee cup.
